before_real_task_dispatch: Record actual GPU model, driver, available memory and any exposed virtualization/profile information
Verify CUDA and native BF16 compatibility with pinned inference dependencies
Verify the returned M1 checkpoint files and LoRA tensor hash
Run bounded synthetic short/long/near-32K probe and record numerical checks, speed, peak allocated/reserved/device memory
Measure time and confirm task/cost limits before any separately controlled real evaluation continuation
caveats: TFLOPS alone does not establish LLM throughput or cost per task
The vGPU product name alone does not establish whether compute is shared
32GB is a capacity estimate, not a measured compatibility or worst-case-memory pass
The 300-second supervisor stops probe processes, not cloud billing
